description: This file 'CheckDeletable.php' is part of the SuiteCRM project and contains logic for checking whether an email template can be deleted. It includes code to handle requests from different views (DetailView and ListView), retrieves email template objects, and determines if they are in use or protected by system templates.

methods.name: check_email_template_in_use
methods.description: Determines if an email template is in use, either by email marketing or if it matches system templates for password management.
